'''Lemmi VI''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. The rare [[Millennium blossom]] grew in [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] there, and immense [[Unidentified jumping creature|creatures]] jumping around the planet's [[Forest/Legends|forests]] caused large numbers of [[Tree/Legends|trees]] to be flattened. At one point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] traveled to Lemmi VI to retrieve a specimen of the Millennium blossom.

==Description==
Lemmi VI was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that occupied the sixth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position<ref name="Alderath" /> in the [[Lemmi system/Legends|Lemmi system]]. It was located in the [[Interior Region]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Lemmi VI lay on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] that linked it to the [[Jovaria system/Legends|Jovaria system]].<ref name="TEA" />

The surface of Lemmi VI featured [[Forest/Legends|forests]] and harsh [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]. The latter was home to the [[Millennium blossom]], one of the rarest [[Plant/Legends|plants]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which [[Flower/Legends|bloomed]] only once a [[Standard century/Legends|century]]. The planet's forests were inhabited by immense [[Unidentified jumping creature|creatures]] that jumped around on giant, springy [[Limb/Legends|appendages]], flattening multitudes of [[Tree/Legends|trees]] in the process.<ref name="Alderath" />

==History==
{{RPG|"[[Alderath Horticultural Society (adventure)|Alderath Horticultural Society]]"}}
At one point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] was hired to deliver an [[Alderath Horticultural Society]] package that, unbeknownst to them, contained a Millennium blossom specimen to a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who was also a [[Collector/Legends|collector]] of plants. During transit, the package was opened, resulting in the flower [[Death/Legends|perishing]]. Fearing the consequences of failing their delivery, the group then traveled to Lemmi VI to retrieve a new specimen of the flower, along the way evading Imperial [[Blockade/Legends|blockades]].<ref name="Alderath" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Gamemaster_Screen.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Lemmi VI was used as a setting for a roleplaying adventure hook included in the ''Star Wars Gamemaster Screen''.]]
Lemmi VI was created by [[Bill Olmesdahl]] as the setting for "[[Alderath Horticultural Society (adventure)|Alderath Horticultural Society]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure hook published in the [[1992]] supplement ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Screen]]'' for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Alderath" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Lemmi [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Lemmi VI, in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />

"Alderath Horticultural Society" describes Lemmi VI as a bizarre environment for the player characters to encounter, with the planet being "both dangerous and humorous at the same time." The adventure scenario also suggests that, alternatively, the Millennium blossom's homeworld can be a much harsher setting, being constantly wracked by [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] eruptions, [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]], sudden [[Solar flare/Legends|solar flares]], and [[Hurricane/Legends|hurricanes]]. In this environment, it is also suggested that the flower itself is somewhat different, being possessed of a certain level of intelligence and dangerous defense mechanisms such as [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] spores or [[Acid/Legends|acid]], and also being mobile, capturing small creatures for [[Carnivorous plant/Legends|food]]. This alternate scenario suggests that the player characters, upon discovering the blossom's carnivorous nature, have to contend with an entire colony of the plants.<ref name="Alderath" />
